segments.name: Laboratory Services
segments.description: Provides technical laboratory and genetic testing services, anatomic pathology and result interpretation by licensed physicians to insurers, hospitals, institutions and patients.
segments.evidence: The laboratory services operating segment offers technical laboratory and testing services and professional interpretation of laboratory results by licensed physicians who specialize in pathology and oncology.

segments.name: Therapeutic Development
segments.description: Pharmaceutical research and development entity developing nanoencapsulated cancer drug candidates and licensing its technologies to pharmaceutical, biotech and research partners.
segments.evidence: The therapeutic development operating segment is a pharmaceutical research and development entity.

revenueModel.text: Insurers, hospitals, institutions and patients pay for laboratory tests and interpretations; pharmaceutical and biotech partners pay for licensed technologies.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company currently receives payments from primarily three different customer types: (i) Insurance, (ii) Institutional customers, including hospitals, medical institutions, other laboratories, governmental bodies, and large corporations, and (iii) Patients, who pay directly.

changes.text: In 2023 the company reorganized and increased its reportable segments from one segment to two.
changes.evidence: In 2023, the Company changed the structure of its internal organization and increased the number of reportable segments from one segment to two segments, a laboratory services business and a therapeutic development business.
